title: delphinium elatum subsp. villosum
intro: Delphinium elatum subsp. villosum, commonly known as the Bee Delphinium, is a subspecies of the tall flowering perennial plant Delphinium elatum. This plant is known for its bright blue flowers and has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Delphinium elatum subsp. villosum include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can help to soothe and protect the body. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, glycosides, and phenolic compounds, which have been reported to exhibit therapeutic actions such as sedative, antispasmodic, and anti-cancer properties.
